column1: # CLI tool manifest — consumed by install/10-packages.sh.
# Tab-separated. '#' comments and blank lines ignored. '-' means "not available
#   name     logical name, used for logging and for the ~/.local/share dir
#   bins     comma-separated binary names this tool may install as, most
#            preferred first. Debian renames things (fd -> fdfind,
#            bat -> batcat), so more than one name can be legitimate.
#   brew     Homebrew formula          (macOS, and Linuxbrew if present)
#   dnf      RHEL-family package (EPEL enabled by the installer)
#   min_ver  minimum acceptable version, or '-' for "any version will do".
#            A distro package older than this is REJECTED and the installer
#            falls through to the next tier. This is what rescues Rocky 8,
#   gh_repo  GitHub owner/repo for a prebuilt release binary
#   gh_tag   exact release tag, or 'latest'. Pinned by default so installs are
#            reproducible and the Docker matrix stays under GitHub's API rate
#            where key matches a PLATFORM_KEYS entry (rocky8, rhel8, rhel,
#   layout   'binary' for a single relocatable file, 'tree' for tools that
#            need their sibling runtime files (neovim's runtime/, btop's
#            themes/). A tree is installed to ~/.local/share/<name> with the
#   cargo    crate name for the tier-3 source build, or '-'
#   1. system package manager                  -> brew / apt / dnf
# To add a tool: add a row. To bump one: change gh_tag, then `zsh-update --tools`.
# --- core: everything the zsh config actually references -------------------
# $EDITOR/$VISUAL point at nvim, so this must actually resolve.
# Rocky 8 ships glibc 2.28; neovim >= 0.10 needs >= 2.31, hence the pin-back.
